text: HALT!
zh: 站住！

text: You stand before the Capital - the current residence of our King.
zh: 你面前的是王都——我们国王当前的居所。

text: Without a proper reason to enter I am afraid you must remain outside.
zh: 没有正当的进城理由，恐怕你只能待在城外。

text: Is there anything else?
zh: 还有别的事吗？

text:
Ah, it's you again.
What do you need?
zh:
啊，又是你。
你需要什么？

text: Let me in!
zh: 让我进去！

text: Who is in the capital?
zh: 王都里都有些什么人？

text: Why are you guarding the capital?
zh: 你们为什么守卫王都？

text: I need to go.
zh: 我得走了。

text:
Ha! How forthright!
And WHY should we let you inside?
zh:
哈！真是直截了当！
那我们凭什么要让你进去？

text:
Mostly common citizens.
Some lived inside the capital their whole lives.
zh:
大多是普通市民。
有些人一辈子都住在王都里。

text: A few of them pursue their craft, like our good ol' smith.
zh: 还有些人以手艺为生，比如我们那位老铁匠。

text: Then there are merchants from the outside, buying and selling wares.
zh: 另外还有从外地来的商人，做着买卖。

text: I heard rumors about thieves inside the capital as well, but I wouldn't pay such gossip much mind.
zh: 我也听说过王都里有小偷的传闻，不过这种流言我不会太当回事。

text: And last but not least, most of the royal knights are inside the capital, assisting and protecting the king as best they can.
zh: 最后同样重要的是，大多数王家骑士都驻守在王都里，尽其所能辅佐并保护国王。

text: We got the order from Renbrand, who is stationed south of here.
zh: 我们的命令来自驻扎在此地以南的伦布兰德。

text: It is our duty to protect the citizens inside by curating who comes and goes.
zh: 把关进出的人员、保护城内的市民，是我们的职责。

text: There were way too many troublemakers recently so we must remain vigilant.
zh: 最近惹事的人太多了，我们必须保持警惕。

text: Stay safe out there!
zh: 在外面注意安全！

text: I have a permit.
zh: 我有通行证。

text: I belong to the Icefall caravan.
zh: 我是冰瀑商队的人。

text: I could force my way in.
zh: 我可以硬闯进去。

text: Nevermind...
zh: 算了……

text: As expected. Now try not to disturb our duties anymore, would you?
zh: 不出所料。那就别再妨碍我们执勤了，行吗？

text: Hmm... The clothes and the hood do match up.
zh: 唔……衣服和兜帽确实对得上。

text: So be it. You may proceed.
zh: 那好吧。你可以进去了。

text: Enjoy your stay and good luck with your business.
zh: 祝你在城里过得愉快，生意兴隆。

text: Just don't try to sell anything counterfeit, got it?
zh: 可别想卖什么假货，听明白了吗？

text: Huh... That really is a permit.
zh: 咦……这还真是张通行证。

text: You don't look like the sort to have one, but that is none of my business.
zh: 你看着可不像是会有这东西的人，不过那不关我的事。

text: Do enjoy your stay!
zh: 祝你在城里过得愉快！

text: Even if you could, the door will stay closed.
zh: 就算你有这本事，城门也不会开。

text: I am sure you don't want to end up as a criminal, right?
zh: 你总不想沦为罪犯吧？
